headline: Cloudflare blows out Q3 and jumps ~19% premarket; Airbnb +13% on a beat-and-raise; Monster sales beat, stock still down ~5%; Moderna, Humana, Vistra report today
top_call: Cloudflare just printed its 'best quarter ever,' beat and guided way above, and the stock is ripping about 19% in premarket. Airbnb beat, raised and authorized another $12 billion in buybacks — up about 13%. Monster sold more cans than expected, matched EPS, and still got slapped about 5%. Plain-English explainers below.
backdrop: Nasdaq futures bounced Friday after Thursday's AI-led rout — the Nasdaq Composite tumbled 5.5% and entered a correction, while the S&P 500 fell 4.4% and the Dow lost more than 1,800 points, per CNBC. Early Friday, Nasdaq-100 futures were up about 1.7%, S&P 500 futures about 0.4%, and Dow futures down about 0.9%, with chip names bouncing and October's jobs report still on deck.

ai.headline: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber for authorized vulnerability research: 48.5% on ExploitGym vs 32.1% for GPT-5.6 Cyber, with Daybreak Red-only access at first
ai.why: The bug hunters got a new power tool. Patch your stack before someone else's Daybreak Red key does it for you.

ai.headline: Meta rolls out real-time voice and expressive avatars for Muse in the U.S., with hundreds of voice styles and interruptible conversation on mobile, web and Mac
ai.why: Your AI now has a face and a New Yorker accent. Talking to your phone just got harder to explain at the coffee shop.

ai.headline: TeraWulf says Google is backstopping project financing tied to roughly $19 billion in Anthropic lease commitments for its Kentucky AI campus, and signed a definitive Fluor EPC
